references.text: Moses repeats the requirement to love the Lord with all one's heart and all one's soul, as a summary of what God requires of his people.
The command to love the Lord is repeated along with the exhortation to keep his statutes and laws.
God promises to circumcise the people's hearts so that they may love him with all their heart and all their soul.
Joshua exhorts the people to love the Lord and serve him with all their heart and all their soul.
Solomon is urged to walk in the Lord's ways and keep his commands, as written in the Law of Moses.
Jesus quotes this verse as the greatest and first commandment in the law.
Jesus quotes the Shema and identifies this as the first of all commandments.
The scribe confirms that loving God with all one's heart, understanding, and strength is more important than all burnt offerings.
A lawyer quotes this commandment as the answer to how one may inherit eternal life.
